title: Evidence commit identity
responsibility: Reads the repository’s configured Git identity and supplies fallback author and committer environment values without changing Git configuration.

inputs.name: commitIdentity.git
inputs.description: Git adapter for the repository whose user.name and user.email should be read.

outputs.name: commitIdentity
outputs.description: Author and committer name/email environment entries. Missing or empty settings fall back to Harness and harness@localhost.
